Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.dst: Habla con Kelight en la entrada del Templo de las leyendas, cerca de {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.dst: ¡Veo que quieres entrar en este poderoso templo! No lo niegues, lo veo en tus ojos.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.dst: Es lo natural, al fin y al cabo: ¡querer unirse a las ilustres filas de las Leyendas, como yo!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.dst: Tendrás que demostrar tu valía luchando contra una bestia poderosa, oculta en el fondo de esta cueva.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.dst: Hm... ¡A simple vista no tienes nada de especial! ¡Por lo que veo, bien podrías ser un soldado raso!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.dst: Dime, ¿por qué habría de darte esta oportunidad? Porque hasta ahora no me impresionas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.dst: ¿Que eres tozudo? ¡Ja! No me hagas reír. ¿Crees que eres el primero que intenta entrar sin nada grande que mostrar?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.dst: Claro que no. Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo verdaderamente impresionante que mostrar.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.dst: ...¿Y? No esperarás sobornarme, ¿verdad? ¿De qué me serviría tu escasa fortuna?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.dst: ¡Soy una Leyenda! ¡Tengo todo lo que podría necesitar el resto de mi vida! Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo concreto que enseñarme.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.dst: ¡Ja! ¿Tú? ¡¿Una Leyenda?! Qué chiste. Por cierto, no eres el primero que lo intenta. Conozco a todos y cada uno de nuestras filas, y tú no eres uno de ellos.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.dst: Ah, de verdad que ser guardián de la puerta del Templo es un puesto entretenido. Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo real que enseñarme.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.dst: Hmpf. Ridículo. ¡No necesito que me convenzas de nada! Está claro que no eres más que un farsante.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.dst: Anda, largo. Si no tienes nada que mostrar, ¡no me hagas perder el tiempo!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.dst: ...Pero- ah. Ya que sigues aquí. Quizá- no, no, no seas ridículo, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.dst: Vamos, Kelight, no hagas esto, no puedes dejar que te ganen con la ley del hielo...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.dst: Ay, está bien. Has despertado mi interés. ¿Qué tienes de especial? Pareces un soldado raso, y aun así...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.dst: Muy bien. Te permitiré intentar la prueba. Quizá entonces logres demostrar tu valía.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.dst: En lo hondo de una cueva cercana se oculta una bestia sin igual. Corrupta, sí, pero nada que ver con los enemigos que hayas enfrentado.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.dst: Se llama Jorkin y sabe más de ese reino que nadie que yo conozca. Búscalo cerca de {p}, en {p}, y pídele ayuda. Dile que te envío yo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.dst: Encuentra la forma de que Kelight te deje entrar en el Templo de las leyendas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.dst: ¡Así que vuelves! Muy interesante. Eso te pone un nivel por encima de todos los que lo han intentado... Pero no basta.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.dst: ¿Y bien? Dime, ¿por qué habría de darte esta oportunidad? Porque hasta ahora no me impresionas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.dst: Claro que no. Anda, largo. Vuelve cuando tengas algo verdaderamente impresionante que mostrar.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.dst: ¡Ya lo veo! Yo también. Me temo que no me pasarás tan fácil.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.dst: Pues largo. ¡No vuelvas sin algo que mostrar!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.dst: Sí, empiezo a tener esa impresión. Vaya dolor de cabeza eres, ¿lo sabías?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.dst: ¡Está bien! Vale. Te daré una oportunidad. Seguro que fracasas, pero lo que sea con tal de que dejes de molestarme.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.dst: Ejem. En lo hondo de una cueva cercana se oculta una bestia sin igual. Corrupta, sí, pero nada que ver con los enemigos que hayas enfrentado.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.dst: Se llama Jorkin y sabe más de ese reino que nadie que yo conozca. Búscalo cerca de {p}, en {p}, y pídele ayuda. Dile que te envío yo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.dst: Habla con Jorkin en {p}, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], sobre el Light Dust.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.dst: Ah, hola, soldado. ¿Qué te trae hoy a mi humilde morada?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.dst: Madre mía. ¿Quieres... atacarle a ÉL? ¡E-esa bestia horrible! ¡¿Estás loco?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.dst: Urgh, ¡Kelight no para de mandar aventureros como tú a la muerte con sus tareas absurdas!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.dst: Está bien. Si de verdad estás tan decidido a caminar hacia tu muerte, puedo decirte adónde ir.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.dst: Abajo, en las Raíces, hay una cueva llena del Light Dust que necesitas.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.dst: En esa cueva viven corruptos poderosos, así que ten mucho cuidado al cogerlo, y tráemelo en cuanto lo encuentres.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.dst: Encuentra la caverna de Light Dust que hay cerca del Portal, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.dst: Consigue [{~} Light Dust] en la cueva de [{~}, {~}, -{~}] y llévaselo a Jorkin, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.dst: ¿Tienes el Light Dust? Dámelo, quiero comprobar algo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.dst: Ah, justo lo que pensaba. Hasta esta luz la ha manchado la Corrupción. No puedes luchar con él, lo siento; vete a casa.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.dst: ...urgh, no hay quien te engañe, ¿eh? De verdad estás decidido a intentar luchar contra él.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.dst: Bueno, no mentía al decir que el Light Dust estaba corrompido, pero hay una forma de purificarlo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.dst: Un viejo conocido mío, Rayshyroth, tiene un método. Vive en {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.dst: Sabe aún más sobre esa... cosa que yo tras años estudiando el Nether. Quizá él consiga quitarte la idea de la cabeza.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.dst: Visita a Rayshyroth en {p}, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}], para purificar el polvo

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.dst: ¿Oh? Pues saludos. ¿Qué te trae a nuestra isla tranquila y solitaria, y además hasta aquí arriba?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.dst: Puedo hacerlo, desde luego, pero necesitaré materiales. A estas alturas nada que no puedas conseguir, ¿verdad?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.dst: Verás, debajo de mi casa hay un manantial del que brota un poderoso flujo mágico.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.dst: Si se altera, genera un vapor mágico único que puedo usar para purificarte el polvo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.dst: Diría que, con lo corrompido que está esto, necesitaré al menos [{~} Sky Vapor] para la tarea.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.dst: Encuentra la cueva de {p} donde se acumula el Sky Flux, en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.dst: Dale [{~} Sky Vapor] a Rayshyroth en [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.dst: ¡Ajá, vuelves con el Sky Vapor! Siento lo de la subida; hasta a mí me resulta incómoda a veces.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.dst: Mientras hago el ritual para purificar esto, quisiera preguntarte algo. ¿Sabes exactamente contra qué vas a luchar?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.dst: No pongas esa cara; sé perfectamente para qué quieres el Light Dust. El casco que protege de la corrupción... para poder luchar contra el Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.dst: Nunca se volvió a saber del pobre hombre... hasta que las hordas corruptas empezaron a brotar del Nether, con él a la cabeza. Un poco irónico, ¿no? Guio a los mineros en vida y a los corruptos en la muerte.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: His mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.dst: Su cuadrilla de mineros no duró ni unos minutos allí. Él mismo masacró a cada uno de sus hombres, y a miles más. Las energías del Nether lo han vuelto monstruosamente poderoso.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.dst: ...aunque las historias difieren. Algunos dicen que Bak'al fue el primero en entrar en el portal y que el Corrupter of Worlds era solo una bestia del Nether. Pero que la verdad sea confusa no cambia su fuerza.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.dst: Recuerda solo que nadie, salvo el engreído de Kelight, te tendrá en menos si decides no luchar contra él.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.dst: Muéstrale el [Purified Light Dust] a Kelight en la entrada del Templo de las leyendas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.src: Hah. Took you long enough. This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.dst: Ja. Ya era hora. Esto es el Light Dust, supongo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.dst: Necesitarás un objeto que concentre la magia a tu alrededor, mejor algo que puedas llevar puesto. Hm... ¿Qué tal un casco? Desde luego, haría maravillas con tu pobre sentido del estilo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.dst: Ejem. En cuanto a hacerlo... solo conozco a un hombre capaz de forjar una armadura que garantice tu seguridad.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.dst: Por desgracia, será difícil dar con él. Se llamaba Garull, ¡y era el mejor artesano que he conocido! Un poco excéntrico, eso sí.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.dst: Siempre despotricaba sobre los creepers... creía de verdad que existían, ¿te lo imaginas? Menuda sarta de tonterías.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank had ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.dst: Tal como están las cosas, no tengo ni idea de dónde encontrarlo. Habló varias veces de querer investigar las Pigman Ravines, aunque ninguno de los nuestros lo vio nunca allí.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.dst: En cualquier caso, ¡por algún sitio hay que empezar! Si logras encontrarlo y convencerlo de que te haga el casco, vuelve aquí y seguiremos.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.dst: Encuentra a Garull, el artesano obsesionado con los creepers, en algún lugar de {p}, por [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.dst: ¡GUAH! ¡Dios, no me des esos sustos! ¿Quién...? ¡¿Quién eres tú?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.dst: Ah, ¿te manda Kelight a por un casco de protección? Puedo hacerlo, claro, pero hay unas cuantas complicaciones.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.dst: Verás, para mis armaduras suelo usar algo llamado Touroto Hide. Es resistentísima, aguanta la magia y cuesta mucho romperla.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.dst: Pero eso también hace que matar a los propios Touroto sea casi imposible. Conseguir Touroto Hide es dificilísimo. Sé que hay un mercado negro en {p}, pero...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.dst: Solo venden la inútil Old Touroto Hide, sacada de los que murieron de viejos. Apenas es mejor que el cuero corriente.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [Old Touroto Hide], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.dst: Así que, para forjarte este casco, necesito que me traigas no solo la [Old Touroto Hide], sino también con qué devolverle su antiguo poder. ¡Atiende, que hay mucho que contar!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.dst: Está la [Aseado Leaf], que crece en algún punto de {p}... tiene propiedades medicinales potentes, dicen que revierte el envejecimiento.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.dst: Luego, una [Maro's Eye Jewel], un foco mágico asombroso de... bueno, de dónde si no, de {p}. Con su polvo podré devolverle a mano la resistencia mágica.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Finally, I'll need a [Coral of Nelfors], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.dst: Por último, necesito un [Coral of Nelfors], que se encuentra en {p}. Con eso encantaré la piel para que resista la magia.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.dst: Lo he apuntado todo en tu libro de contenido. Si lo consigues todo, vuelve a verme, ¡pero no te me acerques tan a hurtadillas, por favor!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.dst: Lleva la [Old Touroto Hide], la [Aseado Leaf], la [Maro's Eye Jewel] y el [Coral of Nelfors] a Garull, en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.dst: Gracias por hacerme caso y no venir tan sigiloso esta vez. ¿Supongo que lo tienes todo?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.dst: Bien, esto será rápido. Por muy pomposo que sea Kelight, acertó al enviarte a mí para forjar esto.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.dst: Ahora quiero advertirte de algo. He oído historias sobre el enemigo al que necesitas enfrentarte con este casco, y ninguna es buena.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.dst: He visto a gente volver tras matar a la "bestia" de la que habla, pero no es frecuente. Ten mucho cuidado si decides luchar contra ella.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.dst: Lleva el [Helmet of the Legends] a Kelight, en la entrada del Templo de las leyendas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.dst: Tienes el casco, supongo. Dámelo, aquí. Aplicaré el Light Dust en un momento. Luego podrás entrar en la cueva.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.dst: ...¡Bueno, suerte! Estoy seguro de que triunfarás o fracasarás espectacularmente. Una de dos, la verdad.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.dst: ¡Tráeme una prueba concreta de tu triunfo sobre la bestia y te concederé el paso al Templo de las leyendas! Date prisa, ¿quieres?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.dst: Mata al Corrupter of Worlds en la cueva de [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] y lleva la prueba de su muerte a Kelight, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.dst: Ni siquiera alguien tan valiente y poderoso como yo podría sobrevivir contra-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.dst: Eh... Quiero decir, ¡claro que podías derrotar a la bestia! ¡Creí en ti desde el primer momento!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.dst: ...Ejem. ¡Supongo que ahora eres bienvenido en el Templo de las leyendas! Sin duda... has demostrado tu valía. Disculpa que te juzgara mal. ¡Siéntete orgulloso de tu logro!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.src: Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.dst: ¿Hm? ¿Qué son estas rarezas que llevas encima? Curiosas, pero inútiles. Permíteme deshacerme de ellas por ti.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#137.src: Comprehensive Guide to Raising an Animal
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#137.dst: Guía completa para criar un animal

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#138.src: This guide shall serve as your one-stop shop to caring for mounts.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#138.dst: Esta guía será tu referencia única para cuidar de las monturas.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#140.src: To ensure that a mount has the room and ability to grow and become strong, certain conditions have to be met.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#140.dst: Para que una montura tenga el espacio y la capacidad de crecer y hacerse fuerte, han de cumplirse ciertas condiciones.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#141.src: To start, a mount has to be placed inside a Feeder to be used. Feeders can be found in Enclosures.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#141.dst: Para empezar, hay que colocar la montura dentro de un comedero para poder usarla. Los comederos se encuentran en los recintos.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#142.src: For starters, a mount will get tired as you train it. They are living beings after all! Ensure they have enough food in their Feeder so they can regain their energy.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#142.dst: Lo primero: una montura se cansa a medida que la entrenas. ¡Al fin y al cabo son seres vivos! Asegúrate de que tengan comida suficiente en su comedero para que recuperen energía.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#143.src: Mounts love to eat or chew on almost any crafting material harvested from crop fields, from fish, even from trees and stones! Just make sure the material's level matches that of the mount for greatest effectiveness.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#143.dst: A las monturas les encanta comer o mordisquear casi cualquier material de fabricación recogido de los campos de cultivo, de los peces e incluso de los árboles y las piedras. Solo asegúrate de que el nivel del material coincida con el de la montura para que surta el mayor efecto.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#144.src: You can purchase tools from Tool Merchants all over the provinces to harvest these materials yourself, too! Bring Grains, String, Paper, Planks, Ingots, Gems, Meat, or Oil to the Feeder to have a happy, well-fed mount.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#144.dst: ¡También puedes comprar herramientas a los mercaderes de herramientas de todas las provincias y recoger tú mismo estos materiales! Lleva al comedero grano, hilo, papel, tablones, lingotes, gemas, carne o aceite para tener una montura contenta y bien alimentada.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#145.src: Certain materials will boost different stats. For example, meat will boost Energy and Acceleration. They need a varied diet, just like us.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#145.dst: Ciertos materiales potencian distintas características. Por ejemplo, la carne potencia la energía y la aceleración. Necesitan una dieta variada, igual que nosotros.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#146.src: Breeding is useful for creating a strong and fast mount, capable of the most grueling journeys.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#146.dst: La cría es útil para conseguir una montura fuerte y rápida, capaz de afrontar los viajes más agotadores.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#147.src: To breed a mount, simply put two of the same mount in the same row of a Feeder. Give it some time and you will see an offspring. A mount is only capable of breeding once they reach an average Limit of {~}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#147.dst: Para criar una montura, basta con poner dos monturas iguales en la misma fila de un comedero. Dale algo de tiempo y verás una cría. Una montura solo puede criar cuando alcanza un Límite medio de {~}.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#148.src: The offspring will inherit some of the parents' visual traits, and will have a chance to gain better stats. If the mounts bred had any previous training done, the offspring will inherit that as well.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#148.dst: La cría heredará algunos de los rasgos visuales de los padres y tendrá la posibilidad de obtener mejores características. Si las monturas criadas habían recibido entrenamiento previo, la cría también lo heredará.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#149.src: A mount's level can be increased to the Limit by training it. However, it can be further increased to its Max by feeding it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#149.dst: El nivel de una montura se puede subir hasta el Límite entrenándola. Sin embargo, se puede subir aún más, hasta su Máximo, dándole de comer.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#150.src: Ensure your mounts have good food to eat if you want them to become strong! Refer to the General Information chapter for more information on feeding.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#150.dst: ¡Asegúrate de que tus monturas tengan buena comida si quieres que se hagan fuertes! Consulta el capítulo de Información general para saber más sobre la alimentación.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#151.src: Although most traits are self-explanatory, this guide has them sorted in a list for your convenience.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#151.dst: Aunque la mayoría de los rasgos se explican por sí solos, esta guía los recoge en una lista para tu comodidad.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#152.src: Speed is all about the max speed your mount can reach.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#152.dst: La velocidad es la velocidad máxima que puede alcanzar tu montura.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#153.src: Acceleration will ensure your mount reaches its max speed faster.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#153.dst: La aceleración hará que tu montura alcance su velocidad máxima más rápido.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#154.src: Jump Height is all about... you guessed it - how high your mount can jump!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#154.dst: La altura de salto trata de… lo has adivinado: ¡cuánto puede saltar tu montura!

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#155.src: Increasing the Energy stat increases the max energy your mount will have. A worthwhile investment if you're planning to travel across the provinces.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#155.dst: Aumentar la característica de energía incrementa la energía máxima de tu montura. Una inversión que vale la pena si piensas viajar por las provincias.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#156.src: Handling is all about your mount's movement efficiency.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#156.dst: El manejo trata de la eficiencia de movimiento de tu montura.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#157.src: Increasing the stat will allow your mount to more easily climb steep surfaces, turn faster, and be slightly more nimble before they reach their top speeds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#157.dst: Aumentar esta característica permitirá a tu montura subir pendientes empinadas con más facilidad, girar más rápido y ser algo más ágil antes de alcanzar su velocidad punta.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#158.src: Toughness helps prevent your mount from becoming startled and throwing you off, in case you're ambushed by an enemy.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#158.dst: La resistencia ayuda a que tu montura no se asuste y te tire al suelo si te tiende una emboscada un enemigo.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#159.src: Boost will ensure that your mounts make the most out of the boosts they find in the wild.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#159.dst: El impulso hará que tus monturas aprovechen al máximo los impulsores que encuentren en la naturaleza.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#160.src: A good Training trait will allow your mount to more easily become stronger and improve as you train it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#160.dst: Un buen rasgo de entrenamiento permitirá a tu montura hacerse fuerte y mejorar con más facilidad a medida que la entrenas.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#161.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things. Such a premise is hard to believe.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#161.dst: Se rumorea que esta criatura fue uno de los mineros que se adentraron primero en el Portal… Por supuesto, como Leyenda, normalmente haría caso omiso de tales cosas. Una premisa así es difícil de creer.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#161.speaker: Kelight

similar.text: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#162.src: In any case, its power cannot be understated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#162.dst: En todo caso, su poder no debe subestimarse. ¡Solo con entrar en su cueva te debilitarás muchísimo, aunque lleves el mejor equipo!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#162.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#163.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light whose origin is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#163.dst: Acercarte a ella te corrompería enseguida, por eso necesitarás protección. Solo servirá una luz del mismo reino del que llegó la bestia.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#163.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#164.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Portal and that which lies... beyond.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#164.dst: Así pues, el primerísimo paso de tu camino para convertirte en Leyenda será… visitar a un amigo mío que estudia el Portal y lo que yace… más allá.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#164.speaker: Kelight

similar.text: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#165.src: Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've retrieved the light you'll need for protection.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#165.dst: ¿Y bien? Se te ha encomendado una tarea, ¿no? No vuelvas hasta que hayas recuperado la luz que necesitarás para protegerte.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#166.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#166.dst: ...Ya veo. Sí, la corrupción del maldito Portal del Nether es bastante potente. No me extraña que esto necesite purificación.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#166.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#167.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was its title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how it came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#167.dst: Sí, sí. Imagino que Kelight no se molestó en decirte que ese es su título. También supongo que apenas te contaron cómo llegó a ser lo que es...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#167.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#168.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds is said to have been a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. It is told he was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#168.dst: Se dice que la bestia hoy conocida como Corrupter of Worlds fue un simple capitán de minería, durante las expediciones que descubrieron el Portal del Nether. Se cuenta que fue el primero en entrar en aquel reino perverso.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#168.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#169.src: The man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Realm of War, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#169.dst: Nunca se volvió a saber de aquel hombre… bueno, hasta que las hordas corruptas empezaron a salir a raudales del Reino de la Guerra, con él al frente de la manada. Un poco irónico, ¿no? Lideró a los mineros en vida y a los corruptos en la muerte.

similar.text: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#170.src: The mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#170.dst: Su cuadrilla de mineros no duró ni unos minutos allí. Él mismo masacró a cada uno de sus hombres, y a miles más. Las energías del Nether lo han vuelto monstruosamente poderoso.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#171.src: Hah. Took you long enough! This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#171.dst: Ja. Ya era hora. Esto es el Light Dust, supongo.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#172.src: I'll hold on to this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#172.dst: Me lo quedaré de momento. Aunque es un ingrediente vital para tu protección, no basta por sí solo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#172.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#173.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I don't know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#173.dst: Cuando insinué que la idea era absurda, pareció ofenderse y dejó de visitarme. De verdad que no sé qué hice mal. Qué hombre más ridículo.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#173.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#174.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank have ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#174.dst: Tal como están las cosas, no tengo ni idea de dónde encontrarlo. Habló varias veces de querer investigar las Pigman Ravines, aunque ninguno de los nuestros lo vio nunca allí.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#175.src: Well? You've been given a task, haven't you? Don't come back until you've found Garull and obtained a helmet.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#175.dst: ¿Y bien? Se te ha encomendado una tarea, ¿no? No vuelvas hasta que hayas encontrado a Garull y conseguido un casco.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#176.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you manage to actually find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#176.dst: ...¿Hm? Ah, otra vez tú. ¿De verdad lograste encontrar a ese tipo? Al menos es bueno saber que no está muerto.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#176.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#177.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight it. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#177.dst: Espero que te vaya mejor que al último grupo que intentó luchar contra él. Seis guerreros... nunca volvieron.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#177.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#178.src: ...You're still here? You have your challenge. Slay that beast within the cave, and bring me proof. Then, and only then, will you have proven your worth.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#178.dst: …¿Sigues aquí? Ya tienes tu desafío. Mata a esa bestia de la cueva y tráeme una prueba. Entonces, y solo entonces, habrás demostrado tu valía.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#179.src: I am proud to have you in our temple! Perhaps one day you shall be almost as great as I am!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#179.dst: ¡Estoy orgulloso de tenerte en nuestro templo! ¡Quizá algún día llegues a ser casi tan grande como yo!
